hook.name: ScrambleHook
hook.description: Takes a fixed 1% fee on the ETH leg of every swap — deducted from input on buys via BeforeSwapDelta, from output on sells via afterSwapReturnDelta — and mints the fee as ERC-6909 claims swept to a per-country vault. Records a TWAP oracle and 24h rolling volume window; restricts pool initialization to a privileged core address and liquidity additions to a locker.
